questions.question: Which of the following is the National Coordinator of SWAYAM courses for self-paced and international courses?
options: All India Council for Technical Education
National Council of Educational Research and Training
questions.explanation: In order to ensure best quality content are produced and delivered, nine National Coordinators have been appointed. They are AICTE for self-paced and international courses. NPTEL for engineering, UGC for non technical post-graduation education, CEC for under-graduate education, NCERT & NIOS for school education, IGNOU for out of the school students, IIMB for management studies and NITTTR for Teacher Training programme.

questions.question: LIST I (SWAYAM Quardant) LIST II (Offers) A. First Quadrant i. discussion forum B. Second Quadrant ii. self assessment C. Third Quadrant iii. e-content D. Fourth Quadrant iv. e-tutorial
options: A - iii B - iv C - ii D - i
A - iv B - iii C - ii D - i
A - iv B - iii C - i D - ii
A - ii B - iii C - iv D - i
questions.explanation: The correct option is B. ExplanationThe four quadrants of the SWAYAM platform are a structured approach to providing comprehensive online education. The correct match is as follows: A. First Quadrant: iv. e-tutorial. This quadrant includes video lectures, presentations, and other audio-visual content.B. Second Quadrant: iii. e-content. This focuses on providing specially prepared, downloadable reading materials, such as PDFs, e-books, and illustrations.C. Third Quadrant: ii. self assessment. This includes tests, quizzes, assignments, and problem-solving to evaluate the learner's understanding. (Note: Some sources also mention "Web Resources" or "Assessment and Interaction" for Q3, but "self assessment" aligns better with the provided options).D. Fourth Quadrant: i. discussion forum. This is an online forum for learners to interact with instructors and peers to clarify doubts and foster a community learning environment.

questions.question: Which feature of MOOCs on SWAYAM distinguishes them from conventional classroom learning?
questions.explanation: MOOCs allow asynchronous learning, meaning students can access course materials at any time, offering flexibility that traditional classrooms usually lack.

questions.question: MHRD, Government of India, initiative e-ShodhSindhu provides students and researchers access to
options: Indian Ph.D thesis in electronic form
Open source software for training in analytical techniques
questions.explanation: A. Indian Ph.D thesis in electronic form: While some initiatives might exist for Indian Ph.D theses, e-ShodhSindhu's primary focus is on providing access to a vast collection of scholarly publications. C. Plagiarism software: e-ShodhSindhu is not designed for plagiarism detection but to offer research materials. D. Open source software for training in analytical techniques: While valuable, e-ShodhSindhu concentrates on scholarly publications, not software for training purposes. e-ShodhSindhu's core function aligns with providing access to e-journals, which are electronic versions of academic periodicals containing research articles, reviews, and other scholarly content. This directly supports students and researchers in their academic pursuits.

questions.question: Which of the following initiatives facilitates the issuance, access, and verification of academic awards issued by the academic institutions, that are achieved by a learner/student?
questions.explanation: National Academic Depository(NAD) is the initiative that facilitates the issuance, access, and verification of academic awards issued by the academic institutions, that are achieved by a learner/student. It is a unique and innovative approach that aims to achieve digital access to education records, that are beneficial to every student and learner. SWAYAM is an online platform providing quality education materials and services to any person at any place across the Internet. e-Shodh sindhu provides access to electronic journals and e-books to all higher educational institutes. While e-Vidwan collects academic and research profiles of scientists and faculty members working in leading R&D organizations in India and abroad.

questions.question: Which of the following is an 'integrated e-content' portal developed under NMEICT. The portal provides facility to search and browse the learners all learning materials includes audio, video, textual materials, etc. through a single interface"?
questions.explanation: e-Acharya is an 'integrated e-content' portal developed under NMEICT. The portal provides facility to search and browse the learners all learning materials includes audio, video, textual materials, etc. through a single interface. The portal cover quality learning resources from top institutions in the country in eight subject categories viz Agriculture Science, Biological Science etc. Contents are mostly provided by the NCERT.

questions.question: NMEICT stands for:
options: National Mission on Education through ICT
National Mission on E-governance through ICT
National Mission on E-commerce through ICT
National Mission on E-learning through ICT
questions.explanation: NMEICT stands for the "National Mission on Education through ICT" in India. This initiative was launched to leverage Information and Communication Technology (ICT) to enhance the quality of education across the country. The mission focused on integrating technology into various aspects of education to improve access, reach, and the overall learning experience.

questions.question: Which of the following statements are correct about National Digital Library(NDL)? A project titled 'Development of National Digital Library of India, Towards Building a National Asset' has been sanctioned to IIT, Kharagpur under the NMEICT by the Ministry of Education. A Repository integrates contents from different Indian Institutional Repositories. There are more than 60 types of learning resources are available-books, articles, manuscripts, video lectures, thesis, etc. NDL is designed to hold content of any language and provides interface support for 10 most widely used Indian languages.
questions.explanation: National Digital Library (NDL): A project titled 'Development of National Digital Library of India, Towards Building a National Asset' has been sanctioned to IIT, Kharagpur under the NMEICT by the Ministry of Education. A Repository integrates contents from different Indian Institutional Repositories. There are more than 60 types of learning resources are available-books, articles, manuscripts, video lectures, thesis, etc. NDL is designed to hold content of any language and provides interface support for 10 most widely used Indian languages.

questions.question: Which of the following is not one of the national coordinators for SWAYAM?
questions.explanation: The SWAYAM platform has official national coordinators like NPTEL, UGC, AICTE, IGNOU, NCERT, etc., which are responsible for creating and managing online courses. DRDO (Defence Research and Development Organisation) focuses on defense research, not education.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the e-Granthalaya initiative?
questions.explanation: e-Granthalaya is an initiative developed by the National Informatics Centre to digitize and automate libraries. Its purpose is to enable libraries to manage and provide access to books, digital resources, and e-content online, making them easily accessible to users.
